family: The fixed total norm-one language in family.md, The language at every length. Reject lengths below 16 and invalid irreducibility headers. In the field E given by those headers and the lengths t and m defined there, parse the tm-bit payload z and accept exactly when z raised to the sum of 2^(mj) for 0<=j<t equals 1. Ignore the tail and take an empty witness.
theorem: At every sufficiently large integer actual input length N, the fixed norm-one language has full B2 circuit complexity at least (489153/100000)N, with zero explicit remainder, unrestricted sharing and repeated pins.
